results.summary: The contact owns a 2026 Volkswagen ID.4. The contact stated that while reversing at approximately 3 MPH to park the vehicle, the vehicle stopped abruptly. The contact stated that the automatic system braking had activated and stopped the vehicle with a loud audible alert. The contact stated that due to the sudden stop, two passengers inside the vehicle struck the headrest with their heads and sustained minor injuries. The failure mileage was approximately 5,000.

The contact owns a 2026 Volkswagen ID.4. The contact stated that while attempting to reverse into a parking spot, the vehicle independently stopped and the front of vehicle moved into the lane of traffic causing a safety concern with oncoming traffic on the State Highway. The contact pulled forward, reset the process, and then repeat the maneuver. The manufacturer and the dealer were notified of the failure. The failure mileage was 4,000.

The trunk cover has raw, unsealed fiberglass on the underside that cuts into your hands. You can see it glittering. The dealership checked spare parts for me and all of the ones available have this same problem so until a recall is issued there's no other resolution.
